definitions.explanation: The degree of heat or cold, measured in degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温度|おんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{温度|おんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦すぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
{温度|おんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。

notes:
{温度|おんど} is the general term for temperature, applicable to objects, liquids, air, or any measurable heat level.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {温度|おんど}が{上|あ}がる/{下|さ}がる: temperature rises/falls
- {温度|おんど}を{測|はか}る: to measure temperature
- {温度|おんど}を{調節|ちょうせつ}する: to adjust temperature
- {温度|おんど}{設定|せってい}: temperature setting

SPECIFIC TEMPERATURE WORDS:
- {気温|きおん}: air temperature (weather)
- {体温|たいおん}: body temperature
- {水温|すいおん}: water temperature
- {室温|しつおん}: room temperature
- {地温|ちおん}: ground/soil temperature

UNITS:
Japan uses Celsius ({摂氏|せっし}). {度|ど} means 'degree(s).'
